description.value: This contract will cover all of Citizen's consultancy requirements for lifting equipment across group. The contract includes monthly maintenance audits and other ad-hoc services.

procurementMethodDetails.value: Award procedure without prior publication of a call for competition

procurementMethodRationale.value: This contract has been procured via direct award through the Fusion21 framework: Lift Framework, lot 5 Lift Consultancy. This framework was procured under Public Contract Regulations 2015, and this call-off will be governed by the same regulations. This is a compliant call-off procedure and is inline with Public Contract Regulations 2015.
